full_inspection: All four complete native images of copy1site057 and copy2site133 were inspected. Every item, body line, note numeral, formula, underline, punctuation mark and margin was compared. audit_133_details.jpg records the typed où accent, shared point before les and unresolved far-left trace. All five doubled-stem group glyphs were directly checked in both impressions. Apart from the eight recorded loci, the body readings agree.
original_transcription_comparison: Both original transcriptions were compared in full. Their body strings agree, but they shared the single-Gamma omission and failed to encode the low point before les. Copy2’s omitted far-left trace is now preserved without assigning origin or textual role. Archive numbers and scan metadata differ.
